item.title: Lucky Chops to perform Thursday at the University of Scranton
item.description: Performance Music at the University of Scranton will host world music/jazz/pop/funk sensation Lucky Chops in concert Thursday at 7:30 p.m. in the Houlihan-McLean Center, Mulberry Street and Jefferson Avenue, downtown Scranton. Admission is free and the concert is open to the public. Seating is on a first-come, first-seated basis. The University of Scranton Jazz Band will perform one piece with Lucky Chops at the concert. item.title: Pro boxing returning to Mohegan Pennsylvania on March 7
item.description: Boxing is set for another spin at Mohegan Pennsylvania. item.title: Price gap between new, used widens
item.description: The price gap between new and used is widening, and farm auctions may be one factor behind the trend. According to several farm equipment dealers and manufacturers, auction values for used farm machinery have plummeted, and the reason remains a bit of a mystery. However, the drop in auction prices has triggered a ripple effect throughout the equipment market, as used machinery prices have stagnated, trade-in values have declined and, as a result, the demand for new machinery has dropped. item.title: GIRLS BASKETBALL: Emotional win for Valley View in coach’s return
item.description: SOUTH ABINGTON TWP. — It has been a difficult couple of weeks for Rob Martin. The Valley View girls basketball coach missed his team’s last three games to be with his wife Heather as she battles pseudomyxoma peritonei (PMP) stage 4A abdominal cancer.
